title: Local coffee roastery
prompt: Build a four-page site for Ember & Oak, a small-batch coffee roastery: Home, Our Roasts, Visit, and Contact. The home page needs a hero with the tagline "Roasted slow, poured fast", a three-card section featuring signature roasts, and a short founders' story section. Use a warm, earthy palette (deep brown, cream, burnt orange) and keep the header, nav, and footer identical across all pages.

title: Professional services firm
prompt: Create a website for Hartley & Voss, a two-partner law firm, with Home, Practice Areas, Attorneys, and Contact pages. Present six practice areas as cards with short plain-English descriptions, and give each partner a profile section with photo placeholder, bio, and bar admissions. Keep the look trustworthy and conservative — navy, white, and a gold accent — with a prominent "Request a consultation" button in the header of every page.

title: Personal portfolio
prompt: Build a portfolio for Maya Rivera, a freelance product photographer: Home, Work, About, and Contact. The Work page should be a responsive image grid with project titles revealed on hover, and the About page needs a short bio plus a client list. Keep it minimal and gallery-like: generous white space, large hero type, and a single accent color.
